restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.text: Please let us know if you have any allergies or dietary requirements; dishes are made here and may contain trace ingredients of milk, eggs, fish, seafood, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, soy, and sesame.
Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness.

findings.notes: Frozen extraction merged headings, prices, menu courses, and alcoholic products into food rows; current official sample menus require restaurant-specific normalization.

ingredientIntelligence.notes: Direct product-name/description positives are retained; restaurant-wide trace advisory is preserved separately and empty item arrays do not mean allergen-free.

summary: Fish Shop identity is confirmed at 610 Water Street SW. The official current menu page exposes 13 complete sample-menu families and 86 unique food/nonalcoholic products. All 46 frozen rows are reconciled, including duplicate presentations, merged headings/prices, stale seasonal products, and out-of-scope alcoholic artifacts. No formal item-level allergen matrix was found after all four required searches; the official restaurant-wide trace advisory is preserved.
coordinatorNotes: Isolated Luna result only; complete official current food/nonalcoholic boundary with conservative direct positives and restaurant-wide trace advisory.
